label: Side Vents + Fixed Belt
description: Side vents with a fixed half-belt share the same back architecture as the martingale variant but the half-belt is sewn down at both the centre and the edges — it is purely decorative, providing the visual presence of a waist strap without any adjustability. This detail is most commonly seen on military-inspired overcoats and officer-cut jackets, where the stitched-down belt creates a strong horizontal line across the back that emphasises waist definition and gives the garment a commanding, architecturally resolved quality. It is a bolder, more formal statement than a loose martingale, particularly effective on jackets with bold fabrics like herringbone or cavalry twill.
